temperature.description: Controls randomness in responses. Higher values make output more random.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion.

frequency_penalty.description: Positive values penalize tokens based on their frequency in the text so far.

presence_penalty.description: Positive values penalize tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far.

notes: The top_p parameter is not supported with this model.
Use temperature parameter for controlling output randomness instead.
Attempting to use top_p will result in a 400 Bad Request error.
